Definition: from G5613 and G4007; just as, i.e. exactly like:--(even, like) as.
BiblicalUsage: hṓsper is the word for just as, exactly like. It appears in Matthew and Luke, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: This word, hṓsper, does its job quietly — just as, exactly like — and I leave it at that.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
